comment: Liquids whose whole point is how thick they are. Viscosity drives flow rate (see Viscosity), so these exist to make 'different solutions flow differently' visible: water is 0.89 mPa*s, ethylene glycol 16, sulfuric acid 25, glycerol 1412 - a factor of 1600 between the ends. Thermochemistry is literature data at 298.15 K; 'viscosity' is dynamic viscosity in mPa*s (numerically centipoise), and 'molarVolume' is m^3/mol from the measured density.
